changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 5 item 4: extracted the admin socket's pidfile instance-lock primitives (acquire/release, plus the shared readPidFile/defaultIsPidAlive helpers used by both the lock and the legacy-admin-server probe) from admin/socket.ts into platform/instance-lock.ts, renamed to acquireInstanceLock/releaseInstanceLock. admin/socket.ts keeps calling them from the same constructor site; its public API, AdminSocketOptions knobs, and chmodFn handling are unchanged.
